sections.heading: Ahmedabad Dental College vs AMC Dental College for MDS: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Ahmedabad Dental College if you want the only recorded year tuition and 2023 figures on this page, at ₹2 lakh a year, an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh.
Choose AMC Dental College only after you have its official fee and placement notices. This page has no fee and no placement row for AMC Dental College.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Ahmedabad Dental College has recorded MDS tuition of ₹2 lakh a year. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed three-year total, until you check the official circular and any state-quota figure.
AMC Dental College has no fee row on this page. Do not guess the fee. Get the official college or state counselling notice for the specialisation you are allotted.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Ahmedabad Dental College's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹6 lakh and a highest package of ₹10 lakh. For an MDS programme these may describe a limited recorded set. They are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
AMC Dental College has no placement row on this page. Ask the college for its latest official report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both sides list NEET (PG) on this page. MDS admission is through NEET-MDS and the relevant state or All India counselling.
Read the current official counselling notices for eligibility, specialisations and bond conditions.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both colleges are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different campuses.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, confirm the official fee and the attached hospital or clinic facilities, not just the city name.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On the data we hold, Ahmedabad Dental College is the more complete side: recorded year tuition of ₹2 lakh and 2023 figures.
